Artifact suffixes a successful transpile emits per .s0ma source, used to locate emitted files for the transpile tool's artifacts list.
The exact authority warning inspect_module places beside every static roster-derived draft so a client cannot mistake it for canonical IR.

The one line every rules-bearing tool result carries about s0ma's own documentation: the topic query, one worked id, and the index to start from when you do not know what to ask for. It rides the tool result because a rule carried there reaches the agent where the same text served as a resource does not, and arriving is not the same as being read, so the line is bounded (319 bytes, the declared budget) and sits below the conditional feedback line and above the frozen narration line.
The build manifest filename (INV-3) the artifact collector and manifest finder resolve inside candidate build directories.

The survival rules, inline: the literal few-line ruleset init_project, scaffold_module, describe_server and project_status embed in their result dicts, so the rules travel in the answer the agent already has and not only behind the s0ma://guide/survival-card URI. Rule 1 cites the enforced GENERATED_FILE_DRIFT guard; the ops rule forbids restoring committed versions of runtime data; the diagnose-from-observations rule keeps an agent that reads runbook_declared: false from blaming a live fault on the undeclared runbook; the check-attribution rule makes a NEW check failure after an edit the editing agent's to fix or justify, since check labels each failure NEW or PRE-EXISTING against the last green baseline and 'pre-existing' is claimable only when the output says so; and the durable-state-migration rule asks for a migration of existing data whenever durable-state shape changes, because a change made only in the creation path (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) never reaches a store that already exists — the patterns guide carries its full case.

One-sentence orientation note project_status attaches to every answer: in agent environments these MCP tools ARE the toolchain, so an agent verifies its .s0ma edits through check and build_project instead of shelling out to the s0ma CLI, which is usually not on PATH there, and then editing without verification.
The frozen common MCP tool-body result schema stamped on every successful or failed tool-body response before it reaches FastMCP.
TypeVar bound to the tool-callable shape so the _safe boundary decorator preserves each tool's exact signature under mypy --strict.
